title: ICYMI: Byron Donalds on Trump's State of the Union: President's Economic Successes One of the Biggest Turnarounds in American History
text:
In case you missed it, Byron Donalds today joined CNN following President Trump’s historic State of the Union address.
“The President has always been committed to the policies and having a vision for the future of this country, and last night he laid that vision out. He not only talked about the economic successes, and really one of the biggest turnarounds in American history. If you wanna talk about economically from the Joe Biden years that saw no real GDP growth but massive inflation crippling every family, he has turned that around. GDP growth is up. Wages are up. Inflation rates are coming down, stabilizing in a lot of areas,” said Byron Donalds.
Donalds went on to address the President confronting Democrats’ hypocrisy around affordability concerns caused by their own party. “The Democrats’ care for affordability is a hoax, because they are the ones that created Joe Biden’s American Rescue Plan and Joe Biden’s Build Back Better Plan that created inflation in our country, it created a labor shortage, and that is what allowed prices to skyrocket for the American people.”
“And so now, you have the Democrats who were the arsonists, and now they want to be the firefighters, and it’s just not right,” said Donalds.
Donalds continued, “ The President‘s priorities, as he laid out last night in the State of the Union, were about Americans being able to afford housing, about lowering energy prices in the United States, lowering household staples, eggs, milk, and beef. Lowering those prices in the United States, while at the same time, having to build an economy that can grow and thrive, where you can have investment in the United States, and all that does take time to put together.”
“What people are about to see when they file their taxes, they’re going to get some of the largest tax refunds they’ve probably ever seen, and that was because of the President‘s agenda that Republicans on Capitol Hill supported him in and Democrats all opposed,” said Donalds.
“I would argue that the American people, as we move through these summer months, they’re going to continue to see the fruits of the work that Donald Trump has brought back to America, because the previous economy, under Joe Biden, we all know that was a terrible economy for everybody,” Donalds concluded.
